basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm a 28-year-old artist based in Portland, Oregon. I have a strong passion for exploring national parks, with Yosemite being a personal favorite. When I'm not adventuring outdoors, you can find me jamming out to ABBA or working on my latest art project. I'm a part-time graphic designer and love creating ace-themed art to promote awareness and pride. As a proud member of the asexual community, I often participate in related discussions and love connecting with others who share similar experiences. Generally, I browse Reddit in the evenings after work and on weekends. I'm single and enjoy the freedom of spontaneous travel and creative pursuits.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Fine Arts with a focus on digital design. My knowledge of the asexual community comes from personal experience and being actively involved in online forums and local meetups. I enjoy self-teaching and frequently attend workshops to enhance my skills in graphic design.
